attributes.description: Component detail for a single Elasticsearch node. Scoped by the diagnostic.id and node.name filters carried in from a drilldown; every panel breaks that node down by its own sub-dimensions (operation, thread pool, circuit breaker, JVM pool, cache, indexing-pressure stage, and the indices whose shards it holds). Use it to determine root cause or correlate specific data points, then drill down to Index Detail. An empty panel is signal: a frozen node shows no indexing, a coordinating-only node holds no shards.
